_comment: KA-28 (kailash-os#28): the derivation-level closure-name census counts per §8.1 image target, committed snapshot. The eval-side budget leg (flake.nix images-size-census) re-derives the count and asserts equality — drift (a manifest merge or a pin bump adding/removing heavy rows) turns CI red until scripts/gen-image-census.sh regenerates this file in the same cycle. The heavy-token exclusion assertions (seclists / gnuradio / gqrx / hackrf-tools / sox / librosa / texlive + kailash-data|sdr-tools|wordlists prefixed rows) ride the same leg; the MASS budgets (MB numbers, images/kailash-images-table.nix) are enforced by the build-side images-budget legs against real closureInfo NarSize sums and are NOT carried here.
